title: Chromatic Troubadour - Location, Weakness & Rewards
description: Chromatic Troubadour in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The Chromatic Troubadour drops Troubadim, a Physical focus for Lune, despite being weak to Light. Its attack repertoire is built around disruption rather than raw damage.

sections.title: Where to Find the Chromatic Troubadour
sections.content:
Location: Flying Waters, Forgotten Battlefield.

Availability: Act 2.

Chromatic enemies are optional, supercharged versions of an enemy you already fought. They are not required for the story, but they drop the better tier of materials and the weapons tied to their base enemy.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Higher-tier Chroma materials than the base Troubadour
  • Weapons and Pictos gated behind defeating the Chromatic Troubadour

Exact drop quantities for this encounter are not documented in the sources we could verify, so they are not listed rather than estimated.

sections.title: How to Beat the Chromatic Troubadour
sections.content:
Same answer as the base enemy

The Chromatic Troubadour keeps the weaknesses and resistances of the ordinary Troubadour. If you have already fought the base version, your party does not need to change - what changes is the margin for error.

What actually kills you

Chromatic variants hit harder and hold more health than the enemy they are based on. The failure mode is almost always running out of resources mid-fight rather than a mechanic you did not understand, so bring healing headroom rather than a greedier damage build.
